video_title: MVP or Championship? KD Sparks Debate

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant joining the Warriors was a necessary move for them
quotes.excerpt: They needed him or they couldn't beat us again.
quotes.quote: Even though he went and joined some people that already came from winning and they had established a record, they needed him or they couldn't beat us again. I feel that way.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's MVP win in Oklahoma City felt diminished by his later rings
quotes.excerpt: You won the MVP in OKC when you were doing it that certain way.
quotes.quote: For you to say the MVP met more than the championship, it just lets me know you won the MVP in OKC when you were doing it that certain way. And then once you got the ring, because you joined them, it didn't feel as good.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley's legacy as a player who fought despite not winning a ring
quotes.excerpt: Charles Barkley dying on the hill with the sword in hand. He on some Game of Thrones.
quotes.quote: Charles Barkley dying on the hill with the sword in hand. He on some Game of Thrones. My dog fought everybody. He just didn't have enough to beat the best. That's cool to me. That is cool to me that his story is what it is, his legend is what it is, we still respect him.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's move to the Warriors was a betrayal of his peers
quotes.excerpt: You basically turned against your brothers at this castle. You turned against them and was a traitor.
quotes.quote: You took yourself out that conversation, but instead of doing it, you basically turned against your brothers at this castle. You turned against them and was a traitor. I'm saying that's what is the problem. That's my only issue with dude.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Young players need to learn how to navigate the NBA landscape
quotes.excerpt: There are a bunch of people kids that need to learn how to do this game.
quotes.quote: There are a bunch of people kids that need to learn how to do this game and navigate this game. You don't get to tell them the MVP is better than the trophy.

quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's indifference toward public perception
quotes.excerpt: What he does get to tell us though is that he doesn't care.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: What he does get to tell us though is that he doesn't care. And that's what I think he's telling us.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I don't think he don't care. I think I think he cares so much.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant joined the Warriors specifically to win
quotes.excerpt: The only reason he joined them is to win.
quotes.quote: The only reason he joined them is to win.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA is a constant barber shop conversation
quotes.excerpt: That's what was cool about the league. It's a constant barber shop conversation.
quotes.quote: That's what was cool about the league. It's a constant barber shop conversation. I'm not tripping off nobody. I still love all these players to death. I'm a laugh and joke, but if I see their kids, if I see their family, when I see them, it's all love.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: MVP trophy vs Larry O'Brien trophy debate
quotes.excerpt: MVP is more important than the Larry O'Brien trophy.
quotes.quote: MVP is more important than the Larry O'Brien trophy.

quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The Stanley Cup and Larry O'Brien trophy are the only two that matter
quotes.excerpt: That and the Stanley Cup, I think those are the only two that are.
